title: Fixed-coefficient tensor normalization on resolving representatives
statement: For a scheme W on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], a ring-sheaf map φ : A → B and a signed-total tensor model a [def-sfb-proetale-tensor-model], let C be the literal coefficient complex [lem-sfb-scalar-tensor-ordinary-normalization]. There is a natural isomorphism e from Q of the ordinary total tensor (P tensor C), restricted to flat-term K-flat first factors P, to a.tensor(QP,QC). For every such P, every flat-term K-flat H and every map v : H → C, the composite a.representative(P,H) followed by a.tensor(1,Qv) equals Q(1_P tensor v) followed by e_P. There is no flatness assumption on C, and no quasi-isomorphism assumption on v. This is only the fixed-coefficient tensor calculation, before composing the scalar-derived counit or ordinary scalar comparison.

proof.text: Resolve the coefficient complex C[0] by a flat-term K-flat complex Q with augmentation q. Tensoring with a flat-term K-flat P preserves q as a quasi-isomorphism. Restrict the model representative to (P,Q) and compose it with tensor(1,Qq). This gives an isomorphism after inverting Q(1 tensor q). The fixed-factor representative comparison shows that this isomorphism satisfies the same equation for every other coefficient complex H and every map H to C[0], not just the chosen augmentation. Its naturality follows by constructing it as the composite of three natural isomorphisms on the category of flat-term K-flat first factors. No flatness of C is used.

lean.statement:
theorem fixedCoefficientTensorIso
    {W : Scheme.{u}}
    {A B : Sheaf (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{u + 1}}
    (φ : A ⟶ B) (a : ProEtaleTensorModel W A) :
    ∃ e : (proEtaleFlatRepresentatives W A).ι ⋙
          ((proEtaleOrdinaryTensor W A).map₂HomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ)).flip.obj (coefficientComplex φ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ≅
        ((proEtaleFlatRepresentatives W A).ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) ⋙
          (Functor.curryObj a.tensor).flip.obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (coefficientComplex φ)),
      ∀ (P : (proEtaleFlatRepresentatives W A).FullSubcategory)
        (H : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules W A) ℤ)
        (hH : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives W A H) (v : H ⟶ coefficientComplex φ),
        a.representative.hom.app (P, ⟨H, hH⟩) ≫
          a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj))
            (DerivedCategory.Q.map v)) =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap (𝟙 P.obj) v
          (proEtaleOrdinaryTensor W A) (.up ℤ)) ≫ e.hom.app P
